_comment: Krea 2 Raw GGUF - Text to Image. Export (API) format for a bitGen Studio image style.
2.516.0 (Tim: "create workflows for krea2 gguff and safetensors").
MODELS (ComfyUI's OWN folders; Comfy-Org/Krea-2 on Hugging Face - the Krea 2 Community License):
Needs ComfyUI with Krea 2 support (0.26 or later - the krea2 text encoder type). LoRAs: model-only (LoraLoaderModelOnly),
4 slots, bypassed when empty; Krea's style LoRAs (krea2_*.safetensors in models/loras) work on Turbo and Raw.
GGUF: the transformer on ComfyUI-GGUF's UnetLoaderGGUF (models/unet). Krea 2 needs a ComfyUI-GGUF new enough to know
the krea2 architecture (update it + pip install --upgrade gguf); if it says 'Unexpected architecture type', use a fork with
Krea 2 support (molbal/ComfyUI-GGUF or RealRebelAI/ComfyUI-GGUF_KREA-2) in custom_nodes instead. Any quant works - pick by
VRAM: Q8_0 13.7 GB, Q6_K 10.6, Q5_K_M 8.9 (a 12 GB card), Q4_K_M 7.5, Q3_K_M 6.0 (set the style's Model to the file you have).
Raw = the undistilled base: 52 steps, cfg 3.5 (Krea's model card) with a real negative prompt; sampler euler,
scheduler simple (fewer steps - 30, cfg 4 - also work).

inputs.text: lowres, blurry, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text, deformed
